designs.name: Orc Skull Scavengers
designs.appearance: Small green orcs in ragged hoods. They carry rusty cleavers and sacks of loot: the first and least equipped ranks of the army.

designs.name: Goblin Thornstriders
designs.appearance: Lanky goblins with long legs, curved spears and boots reinforced with bone spikes. They run low to the ground with their heads thrust forward.

designs.name: Ogre Gluttons
designs.appearance: Potbellied young ogres wear cooking pots as helmets and wield enormous kitchen mallets. Meat and stolen pans hang from their belts.

designs.name: Orc Scrap Tinkers
designs.appearance: Goblin warriors burdened with scrap metal, gears and strange tools. Their equipment looks assembled from a plundered human mill.

designs.name: Bat Scouts
designs.appearance: Small orcs hang in leather harnesses beneath giant, long-eared bats. Broad wings and a downward-pointing scouting spear define their silhouette.

designs.name: Mossback Trolls
designs.appearance: Stocky forest trolls covered in moss and mushrooms. Overgrown runestones on their backs hint at their magical resistance.

designs.name: Marsh Orc Hunters
designs.appearance: Hunters in scaly leather cloaks, crocodile-jaw helmets and reeds wield barbed harpoons. Mud coats their green and brown skin.

designs.name: Shadowblood Trolls
designs.appearance: Slender, grey-blue trolls with exceptionally long arms. Their bodies dissolve into smoke; glowing blood seeps from wounds and seals them shut.

designs.name: Goblin Dust Dancers
designs.appearance: Masked goblins carry paired curved knives and strips of a light cloak. Quick sidesteps and little dust clouds mark their evasive movements.

designs.name: Mogrok, the Gatebreaker
designs.appearance: A huge armored ogre drags a ripped-out castle door as a shield. His other hand holds a battering ram with an iron ram head.

designs.name: Orc Hookbearers
designs.appearance: Seasoned raiders with hooked blades and chains. Human helmets sit on their shoulders as trophies: the first visibly organized infantry.

designs.name: Goblin Bell Devourers
designs.appearance: Goblin shamans carry cracked temple bells on their backs. A strike from a bone mallet sends out a circle of violet disarming runes.

designs.name: Red Tusk Orc Huntresses
designs.appearance: Muscular warriors with red braids, tusks and long axes. Red handprints decorate their dark leather armor.

designs.name: Orc Mirror Shieldbearers
designs.appearance: Heavy infantry with polished black shields. Three silver shards orbit each warrior and crack away as they absorb hits.

designs.name: Blood Bat Riders
designs.appearance: Orc riders on powerful red bats with torn wings. Glowing veins close gaps in the membranes to show their regeneration.

designs.name: Orc Ash Pickpockets
designs.appearance: Gaunt orcs with ash-covered skin, copper masks and bulging purses. A burned rune on the chest signals their magical immunity.

designs.name: Cursed Totem Trolls
designs.appearance: Hunchbacked trolls drag tall totems made from skulls and roots. Dark breath pours from each totem’s open mouth to show its intimidating presence.

designs.name: Silent Orc Executioners
designs.appearance: Black hoods, masks with sewn-shut mouths and sickle blades. Their outlines fade when concealed; disarming attacks briefly light the blade runes.

designs.name: Bloodwolf Orc Riders
designs.appearance: Low riders crouch over red-eyed wolves. During a charge the wolves lower their heads, their eyes flare and dust trails behind their paws.

designs.name: Gorvash, the Bone Patriarch
designs.appearance: An ancient troll giant crowned with mammoth ribs. He leans on a club made from a monster’s entire spine and carries a bone throne on his back.

designs.name: Rotroot Trolls
designs.appearance: Massive marsh trolls with roots growing through their bodies. Fresh shoots cover wounds; protective runes are carved into their woody skin.

designs.name: Iron Ram Ogres
designs.appearance: Ogres sealed in plate armor with ram-shaped helmets. Almost no skin is exposed beneath broad shoulders and heavy iron mauls.

designs.name: Shard-Soul Orc Warlocks
designs.appearance: Spectral shamans with translucent bodies. Three fragments of a mirrored mask float around them; physical blows pass through their smoky torsos.

designs.name: Riveted Goblin Mutants
designs.appearance: Goblins trapped inside living iron frames. Each hit draws more metal plates toward their bodies before the plates loosen again.

designs.name: Iron Bat Orc Riders
designs.appearance: Armored bats wear metal face masks and chest plates. Their riders carry crossbows and heavy helmets; the flight looks slow and powerful.

designs.name: Orc Spell Eaters
designs.appearance: Stocky orcs with black stones embedded in their skin. Their mouths stretch into unnatural grins; magic crumbles into ash around their runes.

designs.name: Spectral Bat Riders
designs.appearance: Orc ghosts ride skeletal bats with smoky membranes. Translucency marks physical immunity; long shadows below the fliers signal intimidation.

designs.name: Goblin Scrapwings
designs.appearance: Goblins in flying harnesses with bat wings and riveted hulls. Reactive armor visibly closes around each pilot when struck.

designs.name: Prismatic Bat Tricksters
designs.appearance: Thin orcs on small purple bats. Three crystals form their shield; a brief colored double appears during an evasive movement.

designs.name: Zaruun, Lord of Storm Wings
designs.appearance: An orc warlord rides an enormous storm bat with torn wings, copper horns and lightning scars. Electrical flashes are cosmetic.

designs.name: Orc Dual-Seal Inquisitors
designs.appearance: Two appearances of the same order: Ashen warriors with black skin and orange runes, and Spectral warriors with pale, translucent bodies. Both carry three protective seals.

designs.name: Soul-Drinker Trolls
designs.appearance: Pale trolls with a lantern suspended inside an open rib cage. Healing draws the lantern’s light through their entire body.

designs.name: Orc Wraiths of the Shattered World
designs.appearance: Ghosts whose bodies split into floating pieces. A vertical black rift swallows them during teleportation, then they reassemble at their destination.

designs.name: Goblin Gallows Fliers
designs.appearance: Goblins on gaunt bats with bone masks. Stolen purses and ropes dangle from the harnesses; riders swing beneath the bats during evasive movements.

designs.name: Eclipse Bat Guard
designs.appearance: Two squadrons: Ashen riders on coal-black bats and Spectral riders on translucent bats. Their colors distinguish magical and physical immunity.

designs.name: Orc Oathbreakers
designs.appearance: Fallen warriors with shattered royal emblems on their armor. The Ashen form bears glowing runes; the Spectral form has empty, luminous outlines beneath its plates.

designs.name: Riftwolf Orc Riders
designs.appearance: Riders on black wolves with violet cracks in their fur. During teleportation a wolf stretches into a thin shadow and leaps out of another rift.

designs.name: Black Marsh Knifemen / Blood-Leech Trolls
designs.appearance: Knifemen are masked orcs who vanish into mist and disrupt defenders with cursed knives. Blood-Leeches are pale trolls who regenerate from red sacs on their backs.

designs.name: Thunder Manta Orc Riders
designs.appearance: Riders on broad, leathery creatures with bony heads and armored backs. A hard carapace shows damage reduction, tilting wings signal evasion and red rider masks mark intimidation.

designs.name: Vorlak, the Hollow Sky King
designs.appearance: A huge skeletal wyvern with an orc necromancer suspended inside like a heart. A dark shell surrounds its ribs; dim light pulses in its hollow body.

designs.name: Orc Crystal Phalanx
designs.appearance: Elite spear infantry with translucent shields of smoky crystal. Three bright nodes above each shield show its remaining protective charges.

designs.name: Fire Bat Orc Lancers
designs.appearance: Riders on black bats with orange veins in their wings. Ashen runes mark magical immunity; the wings glow during a charge.

designs.name: Ogres of the Imprisoned Souls
designs.appearance: Armored ogres carry enormous cages on their shoulders. The souls inside fuel regeneration; drifting shadows and threatening masks show their other effects.

designs.name: Orc Ash Executioners
designs.appearance: Tall orcs with long black axes and glowing seals. They teleport through a whirl of ash; black runes signal magical immunity.

designs.name: Flying Drummers of the Black Horde
designs.appearance: Pairs of orcs ride broad-backed bats: one steers while the other beats a troll-hide drum. Two distinct waves show disarming attacks and movement support.

designs.name: Ogre Revenants in Hollow Armor
designs.appearance: Enormous suits of armor held together by the spirits of dead ogres. Blue-green fire fills the gaps instead of flesh; physical attacks pass through it.

designs.name: Orc Riders of the Last Howl
designs.appearance: Fanatical riders on huge black wolves with bone masks. Burning runes signal magical immunity; charges bring red eyes and an intimidating shadow.

designs.name: Bat Thieves of Black Fire
designs.appearance: The sorcerer’s personal raiders on slender black bats. Long scarves, gold purses and disruptive rune bells accompany agile, restless flight.

designs.name: Troll Guardians of the Deep Maw
designs.appearance: Giant trolls with obsidian carapaces and a second mouth in their bellies. Soul-light flows from the mouth during regeneration; the heavy shell marks damage reduction.

designs.name: Ghorun, the Black Sorcerer on the Wyvern Queen
designs.appearance: The final flying warlord: a dark orc sorcerer riding an exceptionally large, ancient wyvern. Three forms have distinct colors and armor.

host_50.name: Ghorun the Ashen
host_50.appearance: A black wyvern queen with fiery cracks between obsidian plates. The sorcerer wears a charred black robe and carries an orange-glowing staff.

host_50.name: Ghorun the Gold-Cursed
host_50.appearance: Golden rune bands encircle the neck and wings; a gilded crown and dark violet magic complete the silhouette. Golden runes signal magical immunity.

host_50.name: Ghorun the Pale Devourer
host_50.appearance: An almost white wyvern with massive bone armor, black veins and sunken eyes. Its visibly thicker shell marks stronger damage reduction.
